item.dc:creator: Luke Lay and Jodie Hamilton

item.title: Fraud officials charge another over alleged $5 million NDIS dishonesty plot
item.description: Continuous investigations have led to the Australian Federal Police arresting an Adelaide man as he attempted to leave the country, following the previous arrest of a 48-year-old woman in June. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: First Australian death of little penguin with H5 bird flu confirmed on Phillip Island
item.description: Authorities confirm first Australian death of species found with virus near where it attracts crowds to a ‘penguin parade’ Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Australia’s first case of the deadly H5 bird flu in a little penguin has been confirmed on Victoria’s Phillip Island, only days after the state government announced it would begin vaccinating the species. Confirmation of the virus in the little penguin will spark a race to vaccinate thousands of birds, with the government announcing on Saturday it would begin the rollout on Monday. Continue reading... Publicado también por: The Guardian - Environment. Fuente: The Guardian - World.
item.dc:creator: Lisa Cox Environment and climate correspondent

item.title: First H5N1 bird flu death recorded in Phillip Island penguins
item.description: A Phillip Island penguin has died from H5N1 bird flu in the first detection among the island's little penguin colony, ahead of vaccinations beginning on Monday. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Philippe Perez

item.title: Mastercard reportedly down due to 'global' issue
item.description: Shoppers across Australia are reporting issues with card payments, with Commbank saying payments are being declined due to a global issue with Mastercard. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Nelli Saarinen

item.title: ‘My heart breaks into a million pieces’: emotional tributes to Kumanjayi Little Baby at Alice Springs funeral
item.description: Hundreds gathered with flashes of pink to farewell the five-year-old girl, who was allegedly murdered in April Warning: This story contains references to Indigenous Australians who have died Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast A sombre funeral service for Kumanjayi Little Baby has been attended by hundreds of people from the Alice Springs community and surrounds. Wearing pink and some dressed in T-shirts bearing the face of the five-year-old girl, the crowd gathered under grey skies in the red centre capital on Saturday. Continue reading... Fuente: The Guardian - World.
